# Alimran Medical Center

> Neurosurgery, pain medicine, brain stimulation, physiotherapy and rehabilitation delivered from a single clinic in Basra, Iraq. The consultant is Hussein Imran Mousa; patients are assessed once and treated by four departments working from that assessment. Site is bilingual — English at /en/, Arabic at /ar/ — and organises content by clinical taxonomy rather than by content type.

## Primary sections

- [Home](https://alimran.clinic/en/): consultant overview and referral pathways
- [Conditions & Procedures](https://alimran.clinic/en/conditions/): brain, spine and pain pathways with the treatments offered under each
- [Library](https://alimran.clinic/en/library/): unified, searchable index of every published article across conditions, procedures, editorial blog posts and case reports
- [Consultant CV](https://alimran.clinic/en/doctors/hussein-imran-mousa/): training, memberships, appointments and publications
- [Blog](https://alimran.clinic/en/blog/): editorial articles written for patients before their first appointment

## Content collections

- [Conditions](https://alimran.clinic/en/treatments/): clinical reference on the conditions we assess and treat, grouped by pathway (brain, spine, pain) — ~108 pages
- [Procedures](https://alimran.clinic/en/services/): treatments, interventions and surgeries offered, grouped by category (physiotherapy, chiropractic, brain stimulation, radiofrequency, surgery, regenerative medicine) — ~90 pages
- [Blog](https://alimran.clinic/en/blog/): editorial articles for patients — ~20 posts
- [Cases](https://alimran.clinic/en/cases/): representative case reports
